deanMessage.label: About Us
deanMessage.title: Dean's Message
deanMessage.imageAlt: Dean of the Faculty of Computing and Data Science
deanMessage.paragraph1: It is my pleasure to welcome you to the Faculty of Computing and Data Science at Alexandria University, one of the leading faculties keeping pace with the latest developments in computing and data science.
deanMessage.paragraph2: We are committed to providing a distinguished education that combines strong theoretical foundations with practical application, preparing graduates who can compete locally and internationally and contribute effectively to digital transformation.
deanMessage.name: Prof. Dr. Dean
deanMessage.position: Dean of the Faculty of Computing and Data Science
